name: EX-20 Electronic Warfare — 3 Days
description: 3-day Electronic Warfare (EW) exercise covering electromagnetic spectrum management, jamming operations, signals intelligence (SIGINT), counter-IED electronic countermeasures, and spectrum deconfliction across a joint force. 24/7 operations with day/night cycles. Suitable for EW units, electronic warfare coordination cell (EWCC), and joint force EW staff exercises.

groups.name: Electronic Protection
groups.description: Friendly force spectrum management and ECCM

groups.name: EWCC
groups.description: Electronic Warfare Coordination Cell — joint EW staff

items.title: INITEX — Electromagnetic Survey
items.description: Exercise commenced. SIGINT team conducts initial electromagnetic spectrum survey in operational area. All emitters catalogued: friendly (blue), civilian (white), adversary (red). Frequency assignments confirmed for all friendly communications systems. Spectrum management plan activated.

items.title: SIGINT Collection — Adversary Comms
items.description: SIGINT Team initiates passive collection on identified adversary frequency ranges. Direction-finding fixes plotted. Communications patterns analysed: command net (HF), tactical net (VHF). Message traffic intercepted and passed to intelligence cell. Emitter locations mapped to within 500m.

items.title: INJECT: Adversary Radar Activated
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Adversary air search radar activated at identified location. Frequency, pulse characteristics, and antenna rotation rate catalogued. Electronic Attack team receives targeting data. EWCC coordinates engagement authority with Air Operations. Radar jamming mission approved.

items.title: Electronic Attack — Radar Jamming
items.description: Electronic Attack team deploys stand-off jamming against adversary radar using EA pod on aircraft (or ground JSTARS equivalent). Jamming effective: adversary radar coverage degraded. SIGINT confirms adversary radar operator requesting maintenance. Window of 45 minutes of suppressed air defences.

items.title: Counter-IED Electronic Countermeasures
items.description: Electronic Protection team activates vehicle-mounted RCIED (Radio Controlled IED) jammers for convoy route clearance. Spectrum deconfliction mandatory — jammers will interfere with own HF comms. Frequency exclusion zones programmed. Convoy cleared successfully. No RCIED detonations.

items.title: INJECT: Friendly Spectrum Interference
items.description: EXERCISE INJECT: Electronic Protection team reports own communications on tactical net being jammed — possibly by adversary or spectrum deconfliction error. EWCC investigates. Source identified: friendly EA mission using incorrect frequency exclusion zone. Mission suspended, exclusion zone corrected, comms restored.

items.title: Spectrum Recovery Operations
items.description: Electronic Protection team works to restore degraded friendly communications. Frequency changes implemented across tactical nets. Adversary jamming partially suppressed using ECCM (frequency hopping activated). Backup SATCOM nets activated for critical traffic. Full communications restored.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: ENDEX declared. All EW systems deactivated. Jamming systems safe. Frequencies returned to normal assignments. Exercise data and SIGINT products secured.

items.title: Electronic Warfare AAR
items.description: Full EW AAR: SIGINT collection effectiveness, attack mission execution, spectrum deconfliction quality, fratricide incident analysis, ECCM performance, coordination between SIGINT/EA/EP/EWCC. Lessons: spectrum management planning deficit, RCIED jammer deconfliction gap, SIGINT reporting timeliness.
